item.title: House's violently shaking from enormous HGV's, 10th November
item.description:
House's are violently shaking, especially at night and early mornings, from the massive HGV's that are increasingly using Breaknock Road. They zoom down the hill hitting bumps and potholes, so they can beat the traffic lights going red, and the vibrations go through the house and literally shake the bed and you feel the whole house move. Many residents are already experiencing cracks in the homes from earthquake like shaking. I have lived on Breaknock Road for 45 years and over the last year the HGV traffic has increased dramatically, with tremor's sometimes happing 15 times a night or more. Is there anyway these enormous twenty ton vehicles can be directed down Camden Road and up Holloway Road which are much more wider and substantial Roads?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 238, Brecknock Road, Tufnell Park, Greater London
